The '''Eislo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Eislomi sector/Legends|Eislomi sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Eislomi III]].<ref name="VotF" />
